spec2def(wmvcore.dll wmvcore.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# wmvcore.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/wmvcore-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(wmvcore_shims OBJECT reader.c wmvcore_main.c writer.c)
target_link_libraries(wmvcore_shims PRIVATE wine libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(wmvcore_shims)
add_cargo_module(wmvcore wmvcore-cargo wmvcore.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS wmvcore_shims psdk)
